description: This file defines the interface for the OpenCDMSession class, which manages DRM sessions for media content. It includes method declarations for session initialization, license handling, key management, and protection metadata addition, along with callback type definitions.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: An abstract class representing a DRM session, providing methods for license management, key handling, and session control.

methods.name: initialize(bool)
methods.description: Initializes the DRM session with a specified boolean parameter.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on the provided data type, init data, and CDM data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with a new license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key with the given ID exists in the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to buffers, with overload for different parameters.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the key status for a given key ID.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.

calls: addProtectionMeta(GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t)
